bureau: FICP (Banque de France, through the IEOM)
note: In French Polynesia, one of the Pacific collectivities, the IEOM answers the right of access to the Banque de France's file of repayment incidents (FICP); the file's rules are France's: listed once arrears equal the last two monthly installments and the lender's 30 days' warning runs out, written as 60 days, for five years at most. The 2013 order adapting the file to French Polynesia, on Légifrance, answers with a Cloudflare check, not passed.
